text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O, today we're having a sh-show!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O, are we having a sh-showdown today?
It's the day of the Japan Cup. Over at the paddock…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What is it, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Today, we're having a… having a…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: SHOWDOOOWN!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
All our practice comes to fruition—Meisho Doto successfully establishes their rivalry.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I can't believe my ears! Doto… what are you saying?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why? My most beloved subject has chosen to betray me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaagh! She's mad… Opera O is really mad…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I know not mercy! Anger, rage, broils within me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My head burns, burns, burns! Ready to explode! If it's a showdown you want, a showdown you will get! ♪ (You will geeet!)
In comes an impromptu musical show. I figured the news wouldn't be enough to phase her.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto! Are you sure this is what you want? To enter the Japan Cup not as my comrade, but as my enemy?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… And I will definitely win against you, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! Then, stand against me with all your might. My Overlord dash will cut you to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I w-won't let that happen. I'll zoom right past you!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
Things are heating up from all the theatrics. The crowd must be feeling the change in attitude.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, Doto, I'm more than happy to oblige. Give me everything you've got. However…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Know I'm not a fan of half-hearted performances. I won't let you off easy, should you not fulfill my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-understood!
